sources.title: TUD:AI
sources.snippet: TUD:AI Welcome to TUD:AI, the AI model services provided by ScaDS.AI Dresden/Leipzig and ZIH. Our API offers flexibility and efficiency, enabling you to seamlessly integrate sophisticated LLMs (Large Language Models) into your applications. We further provide audio generation/transcription, image generation, embedding, and reranking models.
